newsitem.title: SRI LANKA: Tamil rebels attack army vehicle in north, kill 15.
newsitem.headline: Tamil rebels attack army vehicle in north, kill 15.

text.p: Separatist Tamil Tiger rebels killed 15 soldiers in an attack on a Sri Lankan military vehicle in the army-controlled northern Jaffna Peninsula on Wednesday, the Defence Ministry said.
The attack came as Sri Lankan forces were striking the rebels's stronghold in the town of Kilinochchi, south of the peninsula.

"In Jaffna, terrorists activated a claymore mine against a vehicle carrying security forces personnel. Fifteen soldiers were killed and four more wounded in the explosion," a terse ministry statement said.

Defence analysts said the Liberation Tigers of Tamil Eelam (LTTE) rebels could launch more attacks in army-controlled areas to divert attention from fighting near Kilinochchi, the northern entry point of the rebels' jungle territory of the Wanni.
Earlier on Wednesday, a military spokesman said government troops had killed or wounded more than 500 Tamil Tiger guerrillas in a fresh offensive on Kilinochchi launched on Sunday.
